Sam (customer): Hey team — our compliance folks asked for a clear acceptance criteria and upgrade cadence for any physical-media delivery to our classified site. can you confirm what Redwood needs from us and what cadence/options we support?
Anna (sales): Thanks, Sam. Quick bullets: signed image and SBOM, offline activation token, manifest checksums, and a maintenance window. Do you have constraints on how often we can drop media?
Sam (customer): Ideally < 1 per quarter. monthly is possible but needs approval. zero network egress. also need a defined rollback path if an update fails.
Raj (solutions): Ok. Two delivery modes we support: full immutable bundle (one-time install) and delta-chunked bundles (smaller monthly patches). For quarterly cadence, delta updates are optional. If zero-egr, we'll provide USB or encrypted HDD shipments + manifest + detached signature.
Mike (eng): Implementation notes: bundles are signed with our repo key (pkcs7). verification steps are: `sha256sum bundle.tar.gz && gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz` and then `redwoodctl verify --manifest manifest.json`. We also include signed SBOM (CycloneDX).
Jen (security): From sec side we need: 1) signed SBOM, 2) reproducible build provenance, 3) signed release notes, 4) archive of package checksums stored in your HSM/KMS if required, 5) attestations for third-party libs. Also need an offline cert rotation plan.
Sam (customer): For rollback: if an update fails we need a way to start the previous image without on-site rebuild — how do you handle that?
Raj (solutions): We ship bundles with an A/B boot layout. The installer writes new artifacts to slot B and only flips boot pointer after all verifications pass. If healthchecks fail we auto-fallback to slot A. We provide a simple `redwood-rollback --target=previous` helper.
Mike (eng): Also exposing a minimal local UI (static html served via local agent) so operators can inspect manifest, checksums, and force rollback. Logs are written to `/var/log/redwood/offline-install.log`.
Anna (sales): Pricing tradeoffs: full bundle shipments are charged per-delivery + per-node install fee. Delta-chunked subscriptions are a monthly charge with smaller per-delivery fee. For a quarterly cadence we can offer a blended annual commitment that reduces per-delivery cost. Want me to run numbers for 50 nodes?
Sam (customer): yes please. also the customer wants SLA on media arrival and a window for emergency security hotfixes. are emergency patches supported?
Raj (solutions): Emergency hotfixes supported as signed standalone hotfix package (max size ~2GB). We can do airlift within 72 hours for emergency shipments and provide an express signing workflow (audit trail maintained). That can be an add-on SLA.
Jen (security): One more: offline telemetry — we must not persist any app-level telemetry unless explicitly opted-in. We'll provide an opt-in tooling package that can collect anonymized metrics and be pulled via usb on request.
Sam (customer): Good. Any constraints on bundle size or model variants? our edge appliances have limited disk (500GB) and 2xA10G.
Mike (eng): We can produce quantized model artifacts and prune weights to produce a <200GB bundle for trimmed LLMs. For full LLM ensembles you may need the larger bundle. We can also offer a layered bundle: core runtime + optional model shards you choose to install.
Anna (sales): Next steps: 1) I will table pricing options (full vs delta) for 50 nodes. 2) Raj to draft an acceptance checklist + rollback runbook. 3) Jen to provide the minimum security attestations and cert-rotation doc. 4) Mike to produce a sample signed bundle (non-prod) and verification steps we can hand to your ops.
Raj (solutions): Draft checklist preview: - Signed bundle + SBOM - SHA256 manifest - Reproducible build commit hash - Install-run smoke tests (2x inference p95 under latency SLO) - Backout test (confirm auto rollback) - Offline cert rotation schedule - Media custody chain-of-custody doc
Sam (customer): That checklist looks good. timeline? we need POC artifacts in ~2 weeks.
Mike (eng): Will produce sample bundle and small install doc by EOD +10 days.
Jen (security): I'll drop cert-rotation and SBOM attestation template in 48 hours.
Anna (sales): I'll run pricing and SLA options and post a proposal in this thread by EOD +4 days.
DeployBot: New artifact created: `bundle-sample-20260401.tar.gz.sig` (signed). checksum: `sha256: a3f4...9b2c`
Sam (customer): awesome. thanks all. can someone own on-site contact and shipping logistics follow-up?
Anna (sales): I'll own shipping logistics & co-ordinate with your ops. @Sam please share primary shipping contact and preferred courier (or we can recommend our vetted partner).
Sam (customer): sharing contact via DM. thanks.
Raj (solutions): I'll attach the draft runbook and a minimal playbook for operators (verify -> install -> smoke test -> roll back).
Mike (eng): I'll also include `redwoodctl` snippet for airgap verify & healthcheck: ```bash
redwoodctl install --bundle /mnt/media/bundle.tar.gz
redwoodctl verify --manifest /mnt/media/manifest.json
redwoodctl smoke --suite basic-inference
```
Sam (customer): perfect. end state is a signed bundle, checklist, pricing, and POC install scheduled. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
